lines.text: Pipgourkvo gloub xoushfnou kre'xosh vro-gloushkree vi vroutirk thee kribvrep, vree'voup.
lines.subtitle: Good evening, galaxy. I am Zorvex Quillam.

lines.text: Te-vrute taitlumthua boushqaith, thuaztou tu she tlai saith-pun!
lines.subtitle: And I am Mib. Tonight: Earth, still doing that.

lines.text: Fnegoushgle vreexe vrerkvish, fnerk-krou thithou gosh fni'vreesh'pe tipee'xi vob gle fne.
lines.subtitle: Our top story: an Earth leader spoke for ninety minutes today.

lines.text: Tourkfnepoup vevrou xixeegee vo fno kreeppou'gou gosh xeshthe'krob xoubfnep, vo.
lines.subtitle: Translators confirm the volume was the message.

lines.text: Teshu bush buth taimraitlai thua puzquamvroum, the vruathrouz skrushbain suantlu!
lines.subtitle: He promised a better tomorrow and a much louder today.

lines.text: Soutumqaish qaiz tuaskrouzbouz routhpouthte, qeqouzqu shumqua baivruth quan shaimbevruan thethua.
lines.subtitle: Our probe asked a follow-up question. The probe is being rebooted.

lines.text: Thish vrerkthish fnorkfnib, pishfnee xee gee-xe.
lines.subtitle: [translation: he pointed at the sky a lot]

lines.text: Senshouz-qe bai-puatlai vrounsem qua'skre baishu pua qoumsun, saimqu puz tou.
lines.subtitle: Earthlings check a small glowing rectangle one hundred and forty-four times a day.

lines.text: Theebtheegleep fnekree gee, geegloushtee ti'fnoup xeepkrish xepebgleeb fnovrip.
lines.subtitle: The rectangle has never once checked on them.

lines.text: Roumqush skruanruan reth buan touth ruaruabuz, ruzsemse buanbum!
lines.subtitle: Earth weather: hot, then complaining.

lines.text: Krou thibvree glepeepi fnouvreeptirk glirk, tib'vrovrirk.
lines.subtitle: Then hot again. Bring a small fan and a large opinion.

lines.text: Glob xee gloush fnee'theb, voute'veesh toush'kreefnib tou voush.
lines.subtitle: That is the news. Kravash.

lines.text: Bou-tuamshu baiskruan shoun, suash qou puthqai!
lines.subtitle: Shoo-mak! And please return our probe.
